notes.title: Upcoming demo update: new graphics
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The first visual improvements are waiting for you in the next demo update. Today we want to show you how the game's appearance is changing - with the help of four screenshots: two of them are dedicated to the new menu, and two - to the updated graphics.[/p][p][/p][h3]Menu: from simplicity to immersion[/h3][p]The first version of the menu was concise and functional: a background with a small map, green buttons and minimalism. It worked, but it didn't evoke much emotion. We decided to change that.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547610/c9c01452514cc0e75f0f97f3b522fcda5c2593a0.png"][/img][/p][p]The menu is now part of the game's world: soft warm colours, a cosy office, light from the window and a map on the wall - all this sets the mood even before the game starts. The atmosphere greets you from the first seconds, making you feel as if you are already inside the story.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547610/d38c0be1c10c3c515eec72ae7329555f63bdeba6.png"][/img][/p][h3]The world of the game: soft palette and lively details[/h3][p]The old graphics had a lot of problems: lack of detail, overly contrasting colours and a general feeling of ‘rawness’. This made it difficult to fully immerse yourself in the process and quickly bored the eye.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547610/93261c34b9dfc448152ae9c406ac423eed560e6f.png"][/img][/p][p]We replaced the shouting shades with softer and more balanced ones - the game now looks calmer and more pleasing to the eye. Small but important touches have appeared: shadows from objects, more visible and varied grass, improved integrity of the terrain. All this makes the picture more voluminous and lively, without overloading it with unnecessary effects.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547610/c39ec2d7a0962c5beff3626ae4071c9bc22d7c32.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The work continues![/b][/p][p]We try to make each update a little bit better. Thank you for your patience and support, and we invite you to share your opinion about the upcoming graphical changes. It really helps us to develop the game.[/p]

notes.title: Alpha version DEMO release.
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p]Today, we planned to release a demo version of our game, but we’ve encountered some unexpected technical issues. Unfortunately, we’re unable to delay the DEMO release, so we’ve decided to publish a very early version instead.[/p][p]We're actively working to resolve the problems and expect to release an improved demo in a few days. [b]We strongly recommend waiting for that version.[/b][/p][p]Thank you for your time and understanding![/p]
